name: posture-cycle
description: Sit → stand → recline → follow. Use this to test presets before hardware arrives.

steps.display_markdown:
# Sit
Upright working height. 190 mm column, 300 mm reach.

# Stand
Column up to 400 mm. Screen tilts to a standing operator.

# Recline
Arm reaches out and the panel tilts to a laid-back face.
